description: Professional specification system for Codex. Use when the user asks to create, improve, review, audit, analyze, or propagate product/software documentation, including requirements documents to hand to an implementation team or vendor, SRS/functional/non-functional requirements, PRDs and business cases, ideas, technical designs, architecture/RFC docs, feature specs, test cases, documentation audits, document landscape analysis, and full idea-to-spec chains. The chain's spine is a delivery-grade requirements spec followed by a technical design, handed off to code-forge for implementation: [idea] -> [decompose] -> [prd] -> srs -> tech-design -> review.
